name: Zeke Hermes
description: Route Omi and Limitless voice transcripts into a private Hermes-backed Zeke workflow for memory capture, task routing, and follow-up.
setup_instructions: Install the app, keep the webhook endpoints enabled, and speak naturally to Zeke or Hermes through Omi. Requests are routed into the private Hermes workflow configured by the deployment owner.
privacy_summary: The app stores event metadata and extracted text by default. Full payload and raw audio storage are disabled unless explicitly enabled for debugging.
